payload.body: You tend to speak about a difficult history and the desire connected to it without pretending either one has disappeared. Being known does not automatically feel like being reduced to the story. You usually understand that pain can explain a reaction without defining every choice that follows. Other people often become less ashamed of their own history when you speak this plainly.
payload.astroHint: Lilith trine Chiron can make a painful or embarrassing truth easier to hold without treating it as a verdict on you.

Chiron marks where a person may feel broken, not enough, or too much, and where working honestly with that wound can become medicine they later offer others.
